description: Land Settlement Department - Polonnaruwa North, Tangalle D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No.830575 (24/0538)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of land titles for specific parcels (Nos. 1:97 and 1:98) in Polommaruwa North. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, owner names, identity numbers, and title classifications. The content falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4, with no government personnel changes or structural administrative elements that would trigger Types 1-3.
